attributes.board_name: West Virginia Board of Registered Nurses

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved providers: national certifying/APRN organizations (e.g. ANCC, NCC), national or state nursing associations (e.g. ANA, WVNA), and any US state board of nursing
rules.new_licensee_rule: Newly licensed RNs need 3 contact hours on safe prescribing and drug diversion within 1 year of initial licensure; the standard 12 hours start with later cycles. Waiver possible if no controlled substances were handled in that year.
rules.audit_note: CE compliance is verified electronically via CE Broker at renewal; periodic audits, keep certificates uploaded.

topics.who: New RNs: safe prescribing and drug diversion, within 1 year of initial license

rules.notes: Renewal May 1 to June 30 of even years; license lapses if not renewed by June 30.
rules.rule_quote: Renewing RNs must complete 12 contact hours of continuing education (CE) from a Board-approved provider per renewal cycle.

rules.audit_note: Random audits; documents due within 30 days. Keep 4 years of CE. Missing hours lead to a consent agreement with fines ($30 per missing unit plus $250).

topics.who: New nurses or nurses new to WV: end-of-life care with pain management
veterans or mental health of veterans and their families

rules.notes: Regulated by the WV State Board of Examiners for LPNs (lpnboard.wv.gov). Also 400 hours of employment every 2 years. CE report filed with renewal by June 30 of even years.
rules.rule_quote: 3.1.a.3. Each licensed practical nurse with an active license to practice practical nursing shall complete twenty four (24) contact hours of continuing education, as approved by this rule.
